[17] | Leverage: Start the renewal conversation at least 90 days before the contract's opt-out date. [2] This timing gives you leverage, as it provides ample time to explore competitive alternatives and prevents the vendor from using deadline pressure against you. If you're not using all 120 seats, you can use this data to negotiate a lower seat count and reduce overall cost. [3] | Gap Answer: For a 120-seat service/software renewal, a standard discount structure would typically be based on volume and contract length. Expect a 10-20% discount for the volume of seats.
